text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 炭灰宽松短袖V领T恤，前胸交叉细绳与暗色横条图案，内搭黑色细吊带；浅蓝水洗补丁直筒牛仔裤束入黑色尖头中筒细跟靴，靴面斜带和银链属于鞋的固定装饰。。配饰：红色铆钉窄颈圈银扣；砖红柔软双肩背包长肩带；黑色手机与深色纹理手机壳；透明塑料饮料杯透明盖黑吸管浅黄茶饮；黑色细手链与红色腕绳组合。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Create one complete photorealistic wardrobe reference board on pure white. Image 1 is the approved hollow garment set: preserve exactly its clothing and footwear, colors, material and cut. Image 2 is the source board; target ONLY the largest central person in position single. rNcM means row N column M, two rows four columns; ignore the tiny background thumbnails. Add ONLY these accessories: 红色铆钉窄颈圈银扣；砖红柔软双肩背包长肩带；黑色手机与深色纹理手机壳；透明塑料饮料杯透明盖黑吸管浅黄茶饮；黑色细手链与红色腕绳组合. Keep all detachable accessories separately alongside the garment set, one of each (earrings/gloves as pairs). Do not add any unlisted objects. Do not duplicate shoes or garments. No extra gloves, sunglasses, jewelry, bags or hats. No person, skin, feet, toes, body or visible mannequin; all shoes EMPTY and garment gaps white. All objects fully visible with generous margins. Portrait 2:3, soft neutral studio lighting, realistic fabric and metal. No labels, titles or watermarks.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
